ledgerSemantic.limitations: 15 source SQL column declarations and explicit alias reviewed. Migration file hashes are evidence to inspect, not applied-DB attestation. UUID/text, timestamptz/timestamp, enum, length, CHECK/FK/delete actions, authorization, default generation and migration safety require separate acceptance. Reconciliation uses its own FinanceModule lifecycle timer outside the twelve JobRunner registrations.

declaredSafeguards.description: Named CHECK amount>0/accounts distinct; correction FK; trigger rejects UPDATE/DELETE on ledger_entries and wallet_transactions via SQLSTATE55000. Observed in migration source only, not freshly executed.
Ledger TEXT keys, enum types, NOT NULL/currency defaults, nullable actor/owner, FK/delete actions and unique idempotency/owner indexes. Source hash pinned; no database installation attestation.

Independent FinanceModule lifecycle: immediate runNightly plus hourly timer/unref, Tehran hour02 gate, date-scoped idempotency. Not one of the twelve JobRunner jobs; actual capability is present under different implementation.

openItems.risk: Declaration/storage semantics differ: UUID/text, timestamptz/timestamp, nullable vs required, enum/length, UUID generation layer and owner uniqueness. These are not all missing capabilities or automatically vulnerabilities.
openItems.nextStep: Preserve approved stack/current identifiers and old data. Pin per-field target policy, inspect full migration chronology, test applied constraints/DTOs in isolated DB; obtain precise authority before protected schema/financial changes.

openItems.risk: Reconciliation is present outside JobRunner, with hourly lifecycle timer and immediate run, no BACKGROUND_JOBS_ENABLED/test gate in that method; force bypasses hour gate but still uses same daily idempotency response. Manual endpoint does not forward requesting actor. No claim that scheduler is absent or live duplicate alert is proven.
openItems.nextStep: Specify force-means-fresh vs replay semantics, actor audit, environment gating, timer failures/retries and migration/retention interaction under scoped authority. Preserve nightly safety check; no real manual run during audit.

openItems.risk: Internal LedgerService.postEntry returns an existing idempotency-key entry before amount/input checks and without payload/account/reference fingerprint. Outer IdempotencyService does fingerprint scoped requests, so this is not proof of a public endpoint replay exploit. Some callers may omit an outer wrapper; transitive caller audit open.
openItems.nextStep: Audit all financial callers and separate global ledger replay identity from outer request idempotency. Bind input compatibility without inventing refunds or repairing balances; approve scoped change and test replay/conflict/concurrency/rollback before live providers.

scopedResolutions.historicalRisk: Missing ledger account previously returned all-clear/zero without reading a nonzero wallet. Positive and negative synthetic wallets reproduced it; no real corruption was asserted.
scopedResolutions.approval: Owner explicitly approved only detection/reporting; no financial writes, repair, permissions, scheduling or schema change.
scopedResolutions.change: Read wallet from same client/transaction; preserve no-wallet/zero result; nonzero without account returns consistent:false, ledgerBalance:null, actual walletBalance and missing_ledger_account reason. Existing verifyAllWallets alert path stays byte-identical.
scopedResolutions.limits: Not acceptance of all Ledger contracts, force-fresh scheduling, live providers, other open findings, full Z0 or CI. Current build/related tests recorded in ZEUS_ROADMAP.md.

findings.description: D4 section 1.4 permits every nonfinal cancellation, but table 1.3 omits cancellation for several nonfinal states; neither rule silently overrides disputed-only resolution.
